feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: Thanksgiving storm batters East Coast. And, Black Friday sales to hit record levels
entry.summary: A powerful storm knocked out power for nearly 1 million customers and flooded streets. And, experts predict inflation will not dampen American spending for the holidays

entry.title: From Thanksgiving blackouts to Black Friday, a holiday hit by wild weather and economic woes
entry.summary: A storm battered much of the country on Thursday, knocking out power to thousands of homes and disrupting travel. Today, Black Friday shopping deals kick off, and on Saturday New York City will hold the postponed Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

entry.title: Can luxury save Macy's?
entry.summary: This week's celebration of Macy's 100th Thanksgiving parade finds the department store at a turning point. After years of losing sales, the retailer is reimagining itself — as a higher-end destination.

entry.title: Trump effectively ended asylum. Advocates look to the Supreme Court to restore it
entry.summary: Trump's sweeping immigration changes — an asylum ban, mass firings and new legal maneuvers — have all but ended asylum. The high court will soon consider whether some shifts deny people due process.

entry.title: Strangers connect by sharing stories of their favorite relatives
entry.summary: As families gather for the holidays, we check in with Connect 250, a project from Morning Edition and StoryCorps celebrating America's 250th by pairing strangers for virtual interviews.

entry.title: Being a prepper once came with a stigma. Recent outages are turning skeptics into believers
entry.summary: In the wake of a series of tech failures, major government network crashes and flight stoppages, many people online are looking to preppers to learn how to become self-reliant.

entry.title: At Albuquerque's Indian Pueblo Kitchen, Native American dishes are the main course
entry.summary: At an Albuquerque, N.M., museum, the restaurant is just as much of a draw as the exhibitions, with dishes like green chile stew and sweet biscochitos flavored with anise and cinnamon.

entry.title: 'Memories of a Good Meal': How food made a difference during WWII
entry.summary: New Orleans Chef Alon Shaya's new cookbook shares stories of resilience from World War II, centered around food.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Severe weather dampens Thanksgiving travel, Trump administration proposes new tariffs on major U.S. trading partners, EPA testing for lead contamination after Iowa munitions detonation.

entry.title: Powerful storms disrupt holiday travel, as Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed
entry.summary: Extreme weather that has unleashed strong winds, high tides, heavy rain and floods is expected to impact travel plans of an estimated 81.5 million people as they travel across the United States.
